title: Adopter-facing capability manifest and installed parity gate
rawUserRequest: 建立 adopter-facing capability manifest 和 fail-closed installed parity，修复 Machine-readable Work Item Status Interface、Governance Cost/Metrics、Performance Diagnosis 未进入 installer catalog/parity 的继承缺口；将现有 Summary、Task Outcome、Human Report 作为可验证实现知识能力纳入表面，并为尚未合并的 Implementation Approach 报告能力预留 planned 状态。必须从 origin/main@bce5d48422c77695d8fd86ddb2019de1e77f1194 的独立分支/工作树执行，不修改 verification runtime 或 Summary/Outcome/Report 实现文件，不 merge、release、close Work Item。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: adopter-feature-parity-gate execution authorization and Contract scope correction

declaredIntent.summary: Bind the existing adopter-facing capability implementations to one fail-closed installation manifest and a real fresh-adopter parity fixture.

intent.problem: The template already contains several adopter-facing capability implementations, schemas, and Make entrypoints, but the installer catalog and parity evidence do not bind the complete inherited surface. A fresh adopter can therefore receive an incomplete runtime while source-tree text still appears present.
constraints: Use one auditable adopter-facing manifest as the capability surface of truth, with fail-closed checks for files, catalog membership, Make targets, schemas, and executable entrypoints.

Keep the Status Interface, Governance Cost/Metrics, Performance Diagnosis, Summary, Task Outcome, and Human Report implementation files unchanged; only bind their existing interfaces into installation evidence.

Keep template engineering, adopter installation evidence, planned work, and explicitly excluded external capabilities distinct; never infer hosted, security, identity, sandbox, audit, or calibration completion from local template files.
Do not modify the parent worktree, verification runtime, reports, release state, or Work Item merge/closure state.
intent.rationale: A manifest-driven parity fixture makes installer inheritance reviewable and prevents catalog-only or source-only checks from becoming adopter capability claims.

outOfScope: scripts/ai_generate_work_item_status.py, scripts/ai_work_item_status.py, scripts/ai_governance_cost.py, scripts/ai_performance_diagnosis.py, and all Summary/Task Outcome/Human Report implementation files.
scripts/ai_verification_runtime.py and other verification-runtime implementation files and validation logic.
Summary/Outcome/Report implementation and validation logic, including their existing generators, renderers, and checkers.

Changing existing capability schemas or reference documentation content; the only additional reference writes allowed are generator-refreshed source-bound Japanese assessment records required because this Work Item changes Makefile source bytes.
Hosted CI, CodeQL, SBOM, Provenance, Digital Signing, Enterprise IAM, Production Sandbox, External Audit, and Calibration completion; these are explicitly excluded from inherited capability truth.

Implementation Approach report implementation details not present at the recorded base; only existing Summary/Task Outcome/Human Report entrypoints may be referenced as a reserved verification surface.
GitHub Issue writing, release publication, PR merge, Work Item archive/close, or parent-worktree changes.

sources.reason: Current installer script catalog and script copy surface.
Current installer managed-copy behavior, .ai tree copying, script catalog consumption, and installed Makefile validation.
Canonical Makefile surface inherited by a fresh adopter.
Template repository Make entrypoint that must remain aligned with the installed Makefile surface.
Existing machine-readable Work Item status schema.
Existing Task Outcome schema consumed by the report surface.
Existing Status Interface entrypoints and limitations.
Existing Governance Cost/Metrics entrypoint and advisory boundary.
Existing Performance Diagnosis entrypoint and evidence boundary.
Canonical status vocabulary and evidence-bound capability truth.

problemStatement: Fresh adopters must receive and execute the declared capability surface; source presence or catalog text alone is insufficient evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: The parity gate spans installer distribution, two Makefile surfaces, machine schemas, and evidence-bound capability truth; a false green would overclaim adopter inheritance.

reasons: Medium-risk installer and evidence-boundary change requires deterministic focused tests and full repository quality checks.

executionDecision.reason: The scope, evidence sources, acceptance, scenarios, and fail-closed verification plan are explicit; no external authority is required for local implementation.

preReviewWarnings: Review that every adopter_installed claim is backed by a fresh empty-adopter installation and executable entrypoint evidence.
Review that planned Implementation Approach and excluded external capabilities cannot be interpreted as inherited.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record before-edit and before-finish checkpoints so the shared manifest, installer scope, and evidence claims remain traceable.

acceptance: A single .ai/project/adopter-capability-manifest.json and its strict schema declare every in-scope capability's adopterFacing, status, ownership, templateFiles, installedFiles, makeTargets, schemas, and required docs/entrypoints; missing or null declaration fields fail closed.

The installer catalog and copy surface include the Status Interface, Governance Cost/Metrics, Performance Diagnosis, and all existing Summary/Task Outcome/Human Report entrypoint dependencies without modifying those implementations.
Makefile and templates/make/Makefile.ai expose equivalent Status Interface, Governance Cost/Metrics, Performance Diagnosis, Summary, Task Outcome, and Human Report verification targets.

A fresh empty adopter fixture runs the real Installer, verifies every declared installed file, catalog member, target, and schema, and invokes each declared entrypoint with --help or an equivalent side-effect-free command; catalog-text-only evidence is insufficient.

Capability Truth row states use exactly the four vocabulary values, the adopter_installed Implementation Approach surface is explicitly grounded in existing Summary/Task Outcome/Human Report entrypoints and schema with reservedSurfaceFrom/ownership semantics, and external/template-only exclusions are explicit and absent from inherited claims.

Verification evidence is captured by tests/test_adopter_feature_parity.py, the installer/runtime parity tests, and the required make check-ai-* targets; the active Summary records exact evidence, known limitations, and the requested no-merge/no-close outcome.
guidelines: Keep the adopter manifest as the only capability-surface SSOT; catalog and Makefile entries are distribution projections verified against it.
Do not modify existing Status Interface, Governance Cost/Metrics, Performance Diagnosis, Summary, Task Outcome, Human Report, or verification-runtime implementations.
Use evidence-derived capability statuses and preserve unknown/planned/excluded boundaries; do not infer external assurance from local files.
Keep the source Makefile and installed templates/make/Makefile.ai command surface aligned.
Use a real empty-adopter installation fixture and side-effect-free entrypoint invocation for parity evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A fresh empty adopter receives all installed files declared by the manifest.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Real Installer execution succeeds and every declared installed file exists at the destination with no source-only-only claim.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused pytest creates an empty adopter, invokes Installer, and checks manifest installedFiles and schemas.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A capability is absent from the installer catalog, copy surface, Make targets, schemas, or executable entrypoint.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Parity fails closed with an explicit missing-surface diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused tests mutate an in-memory manifest/catalog or installed fixture and assert a non-empty failure result.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Implemented and adopter_installed capabilities are distinguished from template_only, planned, and excluded external capabilities.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only declared local evidence supports inherited claims; planned and excluded entries remain non-inherited.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Manifest and Capability Truth assertions cover closed status vocabulary, planned Implementation Approach, and external exclusion list.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Existing Summary, Task Outcome, and Human Report implementation knowledge is installed without changing its implementation files.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Current entrypoints/schemas/targets are present and help/validation calls succeed in the fresh adopter.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Parity fixture invokes existing validators/generators in no-write help mode and checks only declared current schemas/entrypoints.
